brand.tagline: Your team’s time off, at a glance.
brand.subtitle: Requests, approvals and the company calendar in one place.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
login.error: Incorrect email or password. Check your details and try again.
login.locked: Too many attempts. You can try again in {{count}} seconds.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask HR for an invitation.

notice.expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
notice.logged-out: You signed out. See you soon.
notice.restart: For your security, please sign in again.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.subtitleUnknown: We sent a 6-digit code to your email address. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.label: Verification code
verify.invalid_one: Incorrect code. You have {{count}} attempt left.
verify.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
verify.resent: New code sent. The previous one no longer works.
verify.resendLimit: You reached the limit of new codes. If it doesn’t arrive, sign in again.
verify.passwordReset: Password updated. To sign in, enter the code we just sent you.
verify.invitationAccepted: Account activated. To sign in, enter the code we just sent you.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your work email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} matches an active account, you’ll soon get a link to choose a new password. The link is valid for 60 minutes.
forgot.resent: Link sent again. Use the one in the latest email: the previous one no longer works.
forgot.throttled_one: Too many requests. You can try again in {{count}} minute.
forgot.throttled_other: Too many requests. You can try again in {{count}} minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Then we’ll email you the code to sign in.
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works great.
reset.throttled: Too many attempts. You can try again in {{count}} seconds.
reset.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Links are valid for 60 minutes and work only once.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@company.com.
validation.passwordMin: Your password must be at least 12 characters long.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

home.subtitle: Here you’ll find leave, time off and the team calendar.
home.comingSoon: Leave and time-off management is coming in the next phases.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address you opened doesn’t exist or is no longer available.

forbidden.title: You don’t have access to this page
forbidden.description: If you think this is a mistake, ask an administrator.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Invitations, roles and access of everyone using Holidays.

inviteDialog.title: Invite user
inviteDialog.description: They’ll get an email with a link to activate the account. The link is valid for 72 hours.
inviteDialog.name: Full name

resend.title: Resend the invitation to {{name}}?
resend.description: The previous link will stop working.

cancel.title: Cancel {{name}}’s invitation?
cancel.description: The account was never activated and will be deleted.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: They’ll lose access right away and be signed out on every device.

enable.title: Enable {{name}} again?
enable.description: They’ll be able to sign in again with their password and the emailed code.

confirm.adminNotice: This person is an administrator: every administrator will get an email.

administrators.title: Administrators
administrators.subtitle: Who can manage users and settings. Every change is emailed to all administrators.
administrators.onlyYou: You are the only administrator. Add another one before giving up the role: at least one administrator is always required.

grant.title: Add an administrator
grant.description: Pick an active user. They and every other administrator will get an email.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke {{name}}’s administrator role?
revokeDialog.description: They’ll lose access to administration right away. Every administrator will get an email.

invitation.title: Welcome, {{name}}
invitation.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your Holidays account.
invitation.hint: At least 12 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works great.
invitation.privacy: I have read the privacy notice
invitation.privacyLink: Read the notice (opens in a new tab)
invitation.privacyRequired: To continue, confirm you have read the privacy notice.
invitation.throttled: Too many attempts. You can try again in {{count}} seconds.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has already been used.
invitation.askHr: Ask HR to send you a new one.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.placeholder: Placeholder text: the final notice will be validated by the DPO before release. Holidays processes name, email, role and leave data to manage absences (art. 6.1.b GDPR); access logs are used only for security and kept for 180 days.
